item: icon sheet, batch 2a (alarm, bagcapacity, clock, lootbag, spotted, vaultprogress, shield, strain), at 48 and 96 pt and in grayscale
critique: Every body has a top-lit gradient, a gloss highlight, a darker hue-matched underside or rim and a dark ink outline, with no banding at 48 pt and the shading holding in grayscale; at least the chest anchor's level. The spotted starburst and the alarm's side brackets are the flattest parts.
